first_round.title: Round {round}
body: Draw your cards :card: up to your hand limit:

phase_action.title: Phase 3 · Actions
phase_action.body: Reveal your [curse]curses[/curse] first, if you have any.

phase_attack_blocked.title: Phase 4 · Boss Attack
phase_attack_blocked.body: You blocked everything! [boss]{boss}[/boss] hits nobody this round.

round_end_status.title: Phase 5 · Status
body: [fire]Fire[/fire] :fire:: draw [b]1[/b] :card: per status token, remove each for the rest of the fight [i]or[/i] discard it and lose [damage]2 health[/damage] :wound:.

round_end_discard.title: Phase 6 · Discard
round_end_discard.body: Put your play area on your discard pile, then discard hand cards :card: down to your hand limit, or more.

round_end_draw.title: Phase 7 · Draw
body: Draw your cards :card: up to your hand limit:

support_without_attack.title: No effect
support_without_attack.body: A support only works after a [b]{kind}[/b] attack this round. [player]{player}[/player]'s support does nothing.

heal.body: [player]{player}[/player] heals [heal]{amount} health[/heal] :heal:, but not above their starting health.

empowered.body: Until the end of the round, [player]{player}[/player] gets [heal]+{bonus}[/heal] on [b]{kind}[/b].

remove_tokens.body: [player]{player}[/player] removes up to [heal]{count}[/heal] of their own status tokens.

defeat.title: Defeat
defeat.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] has won this time. Rest, and try again!

prompt_choose_starter.body:
It's your turn. Who starts this round?
[b]Tap a hero![/b]

prompt_tied_target.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] cannot decide. [b]Tap the hero[/b] it attacks.

prompt_free_play_who.body: [player]{player}[/player] lets another hero play a card :card: for free. [b]Tap the hero.[/b]

prompt_lucky_charm.body: [player]{player}[/player], play the [b]top card of your draw pile[/b] :card:.

notice_cannot_play_now.body: This card cannot be played now.

notice_played_already.body: This card is already in play this round.

notice_not_your_card.body: This is not a card of [player]{player}[/player].

notice_used_up.body: [player]{player}[/player] has used this up in this fight.

notice_removed.body: This card is out of the game for the rest of the fight.

take_from_pile.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes [b]{count}[/b] :card: of their choice from their draw pile.

card_removed.body: [player]{player}[/player], put this card :card: back in the box: it is out of the game for the rest of the fight.

attack_effects_removed.body: The boss attack :claw: against [player]{player}[/player] loses its extra effect.

attack_cancelled.body: The boss attack :claw: against [player]{player}[/player] is cancelled.

attack_redirected.body: [player]{player}[/player] steps in front of [player]{other}[/player]: the boss attack of [damage]{damage} damage[/damage] :claw: now hits [player]{player}[/player].

ward_placed.body: [player]{player}[/player] places [b]{card}[/b] next to their hero card. It can prevent one of the boss's @-abilities against [player]{player}[/player].

ward_ready.body: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player] prevents the boss's next @-ability up to [b]{strength}[/b].

shield_breaker.body: Shield destroyed! [boss]{boss}[/boss] loses [damage]{damage} health[/damage] :wound: at once.

prompt_if_healthy.body: Does [player]{player}[/player] now have [b]{health} health[/b] :health: or more?

prompt_chosen_hero.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] the card of [player]{player}[/player] is for.

prompt_remove_tokens_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] who removes up to [heal]{count}[/heal] status tokens.

prompt_redirect_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] whose boss attack :claw: [player]{player}[/player] takes on.

prompt_use_ward.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] uses an @-ability against [player]{player}[/player]. Discard [b]{card}[/b] to prevent it?

prompt_top_card_or_item.body: [player]{player}[/player], play the [b]top card of your draw pile[/b] :card: or use [b]Grandpa's Glass Eye[/b].

prompt_attack_or_item.body: [player]{player}[/player], play a hand card :card: with an [b]attack[/b] or use the [b]Waterskin[/b].

notice_still_in_play.body: This card still lies next to the hero card of [player]{player}[/player].

notice_not_here.body: This item cannot be used here.

prompt_search_pile.body: [player]{player}[/player], search your [b]draw pile[/b] for a card and play it :card:.

searched_card_removed.body: [player]{player}[/player] shuffles their draw pile and puts [b]{card}[/b] back in the box: it is out of the game for the rest of the fight.

prompt_discard_or_top.body: [player]{player}[/player], play a card from your [b]discard pile[/b] or the [b]top card of your draw pile[/b] :card:.

played_card_removed.body: [player]{player}[/player] puts [b]{card}[/b] back in the box: it is out of the game for the rest of the fight.

toxin_ready.body: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player]: from now on, each [poison]poison[/poison] :poison: of the boss costs it [damage]{damage} health[/damage] :wound: more at the end of the round.

nothing_to_repeat.body: No card with an attack has been played yet, so nothing takes effect again.

attack_delayed.body: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player] only goes off at the start of their first turn next round.

prompt_halve_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] whose boss attack :claw: is halved.

attack_halved.body: The boss attack against [player]{player}[/player] is halved to [damage]{damage} damage[/damage] :claw: and loses its extra effect.

remove_curse.body: [player]{player}[/player] puts 1 active [curse]curse[/curse] of any hero on the curse discard pile.

card_to_pile.body: [player]{player}[/player] puts [b]{count}[/b] other hand card :card: on top of their draw pile.

prompt_play_top_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] who plays the top [b]{count}[/b] :card: of their draw pile.

boss_poison.body: The [poison]poison[/poison] works! [boss]{boss}[/boss] has [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison: and loses [damage]{damage} health[/damage] :wound:.

example_reminder.body: [i]Remember:[/i] poisoned heroes lose [damage]1 health[/damage] :wound: at the end of each round.

prompt_lower_shield.body: [player]{player}[/player] lowers a shield by [damage]{amount}[/damage]. [b]Tap the shield.[/b]

no_shield_to_lower.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] has no shield left: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player] does nothing.

prompt_poison_on_attack_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b]: whenever a boss attack of [damage]{threshold} damage[/damage] :claw: or more hits them, the boss gets [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison:.

poison_on_attack_ready.body: [b]{card}[/b]: until the end of the fight, the boss gets [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison: whenever it attacks [player]{player}[/player] with [damage]{threshold} damage[/damage] :claw: or more.

poison_on_attack.body: [b]{card}[/b] strikes back: [boss]{boss}[/boss] attacks [player]{player}[/player] and gets [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison:.

attacks_weakened_next_round.body: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player]: next round, every boss attack :claw: is [heal]{amount}[/heal] lower.

attacks_weakened.body: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player] takes effect: every boss attack :claw: is [heal]{amount}[/heal] lower.

remove_tokens_everyone.body: Each hero removes up to [heal]{count}[/heal] of their own status tokens.

form_thorn.title: Thorn Form
form_thorn.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes the Thorn Form: their attacks :damage: and supports get [heal]+1[/heal].

form_blossom.title: Blossom Form
form_blossom.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes the Blossom Form: each time their attacks :damage: or supports cost the boss health, they heal [heal]3 health[/heal] :heal:.

form_bark.title: Bark Form
form_bark.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes the Bark Form: their protection :protection: gets [heal]+1[/heal].

transfer_health.body: [player]{player}[/player] may give as much of their health :health: as they like to [b]exactly one[/b] other hero.

card_back_to_pile.body: [player]{player}[/player] does not discard [b]{card}[/b], but shuffles the card :card: back into their draw pile.

prompt_redraw_hand_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] who discards any number of hand cards :card: and then draws up to their hand limit.

redraw_hand.body: [player]{player}[/player] discards as many hand cards :card: as they like, then draws up to their hand limit.

discard_random.body: [player]{player}[/player] discards [b]{count}[/b] random hand card :card:, if they have one.

threat_lowers_on_attack.body: Each time [player]{player}[/player] plays an attack :damage: this round, the boss attack :claw: against them goes down by [heal]{amount}[/heal].

threat_lowered.body: The boss attack :claw: of [boss]{boss}[/boss] against [player]{player}[/player] goes down by [heal]{amount}[/heal].

remove_tokens_group.body: Together you remove up to [heal]{count}[/heal] status tokens, from whoever you like.

look_at_top_everyone.body: Each hero looks at the top [b]{look}[/b] :card: of their draw pile, takes [b]{take}[/b] of them into their hand and puts the other [b]{back}[/b] back in any order.

search_to_hand.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes [b]{count}[/b] :card: of their choice from their draw pile into their hand and shuffles their draw pile.

take_token.body: [player]{player}[/player] gets [damage]{count}[/damage] status token of their choice from the supply.

draw_and_play.body: [player]{player}[/player] draws [b]{draw}[/b] :card:, plays [b]{play}[/b] of them at once and discards the other [b]{discard}[/b].

prompt_play_drawn.body: [player]{player}[/player], play one of the [b]cards you just drew[/b] :card:.

tear_placed.body: [player]{player}[/player] places [b]{card}[/b] next to their hero card for good. When a hero would lose health :wound:, from anything, you may discard it to prevent that: keep track of it on the table.

draw_and_return_everyone.body: Each hero draws [b]{draw}[/b] :card:, then puts [b]{back}[/b] of their hand cards face down on their draw pile.

next_cards_boosted.body: On the next [b]{cards}[/b] :card: played, by anyone, every attack :damage: and support is [heal]{bonus}[/heal] higher.

random_token.body: Chosen at random: [player]{player}[/player] gets a status token, {tokens}.

totem_attack.title: {card}
body: Until the end of the round, every attack :damage: of [player]{player}[/player] is [heal]{bonus}[/heal] higher.

totem_support.title: {card}
body: Until the end of the round, every support of [player]{player}[/player] is [heal]{bonus}[/heal] higher.

totem_protection.title: {card}
body: Until the end of the round, every protection :protection: of [player]{player}[/player] is [heal]{bonus}[/heal] higher.

totem_lightning.title: {card}
body: Until the end of the round, [player]{player}[/player] may remove [heal]{count}[/heal] of their own status tokens for each lightning :lightning: they play.

tokens_per_lightning.body: Until the end of the round, [player]{player}[/player] may remove [heal]{count}[/heal] of their own status tokens for each lightning :lightning: they play.

totems_returned.title: Totems
totems_returned.body: The round is over. Give back the totem tokens :totem:: [player]{players}[/player].

robot_built.body: [player]{player}[/player] flips the last part: the [b]battle robot[/b] :robot: stands! While it works, every attack :damage: of [player]{player}[/player] is [heal]{bonus}[/heal] higher. It has [heal]{health} health[/heal] :health:.

robot_part.body: [player]{player}[/player] flips a part of the [b]battle robot[/b] :robot: ([b]{count}/{total}[/b]).

robot_destroyed.body: The [b]battle robot[/b] :robot: of [player]{player}[/player] is [damage]destroyed[/damage]! Flip its three parts back. With an attack, a support and a protection it can be built again.

card_wound_up.body: [player]{player}[/player] shuffles [b]{card}[/b] back into their draw pile :card:. It is now wound up.

card_back_to_hand.body: [player]{player}[/player] may take [b]{card}[/b] back into their hand and play it again this round.

poison_burst.body: [b]{card}[/b]: [boss]{boss}[/boss] has [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison: and loses [damage]{damage} health[/damage] :wound: at once.

prompt_play_from_top.body: [player]{player}[/player], look at the [b]top {look} cards[/b] of your draw pile and play one of them :card:.

play_from_top_rest.body: [player]{player}[/player] puts the other [b]{count}[/b] :card: back on top of or below their draw pile, in any order.

random_hand_cards.body: [b]{card}[/b]: for the rest of the round, whenever [player]{player}[/player] plays a hand card :card:, it has to be a [b]random[/b] one.

random_hand_reminder.body: [i]Remember:[/i] [player]{player}[/player] plays a [b]random[/b] hand card :card: this round.

prompt_reset_health_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] whose health :health: goes back to their starting health.

reset_health.body: [player]{player}[/player] sets their health :health: back to their [heal]starting health[/heal].

boss_away_missed.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] is out of reach: the attack has no effect.

mirefang_out_of_reach.title: Under Water
mirefang_out_of_reach.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] lurks deep under the water. Your attack does not reach it.

mirefang_poison_shield.title: Poison Shield
mirefang_poison_shield.body: [player]{player}[/player] hits the [poison]poison shield[/poison] and gets [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison:.

mirefang_dive.title: Dive
body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] dives into the black water. Its shields and attacks are gone, and no attack reaches it.
It lurks beneath [player]{player}[/player]: surfacing, it bites for [damage]{damage} damage[/damage] :claw: and [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison:.
Each hero gets [heal]+1 action[/heal] to prepare.

mirefang_surfaces.title: Surfacing
mirefang_surfaces.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] bursts out of the water, right at [player]{player}[/player]!

mirefang_spit.title: Venom Spit
mirefang_spit.body: Hurt by the blow, [boss]{boss}[/boss] spits [poison]venom[/poison] at [player]{player}[/player], who gets [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison:.

mirefang_tail.title: Tail Lash
mirefang_tail.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] lashes its huge tail across the mire: each hero loses [damage]{damage} health[/damage] :wound:.

mirefang_enraged.title: Enraged
mirefang_enraged.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] is enraged! From now on, its attacks :claw: and shields are stronger, and its [poison]poison shield[/poison] poisons more.
